summary: This bill requires the Department of Homeland Security to provide Congress with all documents and materials related to officer-involved shootings resulting in injury or death, and any deaths occurring in DHS custody, that happened on or after January 20, 2025.

scores.thoughts: This bill requires the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) to provide documents and materials related to use-of-force incidents and deaths in custody. Since DHS components like ICE and CBP are heavily involved in immigration enforcement, increased transparency regarding their actions could indirectly affect how immigration laws are enforced and perceived, potentially influencing policies related to border security and treatment of immigrants. However, the bill's primary focus is on transparency and oversight of use-of-force, not on immigration policy itself.
